changelog: Phase 1 polish. Dashboard, unibox, and warmup pages now auto-refresh every 20-30s so new replies and stats show up without hitting refresh. Login is timing-attack resistant and password minimum is now 8 chars. Warmup coordinator URL is now configurable (WARMUP_COORDINATOR_URL env var, set to 'disabled' to turn off phone-home entirely). DNSBL check is disabled by default because the previous implementation queried the wrong IPs and reported meaningless results — set ENABLE_DNSBL_CHECK=true to opt back in. Mailbox reply rate now only counts replies to actual outbound emails, not every inbound message.
